name: Somlóvásárhely (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over green with a narrow serrated stripe of red, white and green along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Somlóvásárhely (a green shield with a yellow patriarchal cross between two towers and a castle wall) above the name SOMLÓVÁSÁRHELY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
